headline: Redcoats Carry Bunker Hill After Two Bloody Repulses
dispatch: British regulars under General Howe carried the rebel fortification atop Bunker Hill this afternoon after sustaining severe losses in two previous charges up the exposed slope. Colonial defenders held their fire until the advancing lines were nearly upon them, inflicting grievous casualties before ammunition ran low and forced a withdrawal. The Crown holds the height, but the cost in officers and men has stunned the army command in Boston.
answer: British forces storm and take Bunker Hill, Boston, 1775
